questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence. **

(Hardly nothing) was offered to the victims of the earthquake.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is** Hardly anything.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:-**

 
• In the above given sentence,** 'hardly anything'** will be used.
 
• ** **Hardly anything means** ‘almost nothing or very little’**.
 
• This fits the sentence better than the other options and is the correct answer.
 
• **'Hardly nothing'** is incorrect.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is** *Hardly anything was offered to the victims of the earthquake.*

questions.question:
The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.

P: This is despite the fact that there is a rampant migration of rural families to urban centres.

Q: Generally the gains of being a unit of the urban population are less than the disadvantages and risks that are inbuilt in the urban life.

R: Rural population still dominates the urban population as far as the number is considered.

S: India is a country of villages.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SRQP**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, or the starting of an incident
 
• Part S will be the first sentence because the sentence is an independent general statement and introduces the 'villages' on which 4 statements are based.
 
• Part R will be the next sentence because it supports the first statement of why India is a country of villages.
 
• Part Q will be the next sentence because it tells us **that cons of living in urban life are more than the pros.**
 
• Lastly, Part P will be used because it contains the preposition 'despite'. You use despite to introduce a fact which makes the other part of the sentence surprising. P mentions that though the cons of living in urban overweigh its pros, still people are migrating to urban centers.

**The correct sequence is:__** *India is a country of villages. The rural population still dominates the urban population as far as the number is considered. Generally, the gains of being a unit of the urban population are less than the disadvantages and risks that are inbuilt in the urban life. This is despite the fact that there is a rampant migration of rural families to urban centres*

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive voice. Out of four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active voice. **

The residents celebrated Diwali.

options.text: Celebration of Diwali was done by the residents.
Diwali has been celebrated by the residents.
Diwali was celebrated by the residents.
Diwali is celebrated by the residents.

questions.solution:
**Correct Answer:** Diwali was celebrated by the residents. 

When converting to passive voice, the action of celebrating Diwali comes first in the sentence followed by the doer. Sentence 3 does exactly that and is therefore, the correct answer. Note that the simple past tense is maintained while converting, which makes sentences 2 and 4 incorrect.

questions.question:
**In the following question, a sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect speech. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in ****Indirect****/Direct speech. **

The foreman said to his workers "I cannot pay you higher wages."

options.text: The foreman warned his workers that he cannot pay them higher wages.
The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.
The foreman told his workers that they could not be paid higher wages.
The foreman forbid his workers to pay higher wages.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given question we have to change it into Indirect Speech. 
 
• The Process of Transformation as follows:
 
 
• 'Said' will be changed into **'told'**. Because the reporting verb has an object after 'said'.
 
• Comma and inverted comma will be added.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added.
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he'.
 
• 'you' will be changed into **'them'**
 
• ''Can't'' will be changed into ''couldn't''.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct Answer:__* The foreman told his workers that he could not pay them higher wages.*

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No error'. **

 The reason for (1)/ his failure is because (2)/ he didn't study at all. (3)/ No Error (4)
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__2__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'his failure is that' **should be there in place of **'his failure is because'**
 
• There are two reasons why 'the reason is' not followed by 'because':
 
 
• ***Because*** is redundant because it means ‘for the reason that’ (The reason is for the reason that…)
 
• ***Is*** is a linking verb and should not be followed by an adverbial clause introduced by the conjunction ***because.***
 
 
 
• ***​*****Example: **
 
 
• **​***The reason why he was rejected was because he was too young. * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dac933c583d88d7fbb203b5b7a234cec3fd685de718148e906afdace8b6dc680.png] __

• __​__**Thus, the correct sentence is: ***The reason for his failure is **that **he didn't study at all.*

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a coherent paragraph.**

P: It has been the handmaid of the ruling class.

Q: Therefore, ever since the dawn of civilization, persons in power have always tried to supervise or control education.

R: Education is an instrument that imparts knowledge and therefore, indirectly controls power.

S: It is an old saying that knowledge is power.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**SRQP**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, or the starting of an incident
 
• Part S will be the first sentence because it is clear that that the flow of topics is from knowledge to power to education. Therefore, Sentence S comes first introducing knowledge and power.
 
• Part R will be the next sentence because it mentions the agent that imparts 'knowledge'
 
• Part Q will be the next sentence because it starts with 'therefore'. You use therefore to introduce a logical result or conclusion. Here it is concluding why people in power during the ancient era try to supervise or control education.
 
• Lastly, Part P will be used because it concludes all the sentences.

**The correct sequence is:__** *It is an old saying that knowledge is power. Education is an instrument that imparts knowledge and therefore, indirectly controls power. Therefore, ever since the dawn of civilization, persons in power have always tried to supervise or control education. It has been the handmaid of the ruling class.*
